title: Spindle Overload
description: Spindle drive current exceeded 115% of rated load for more than 3 seconds.
recommended_action: Check tool wear, verify programmed feed rate against material spec, confirm coolant flow to spindle bearing jacket. Do not reset and re-run without addressing root cause.

title: Spindle Overtemp
recommended_action: Stop spindle immediately, allow minimum 30-minute cooldown, check coolant jacket flow rate.

title: Spindle Orientation Timeout
description: Spindle failed to reach tool-change orientation within 2 seconds.
recommended_action: Check encoder for fault, inspect tool-change carousel for mechanical obstruction.

title: X-Axis Positioning Deviation
description: Measured axis position deviates from commanded position beyond tolerance.
recommended_action: Check backlash compensation value under Axis > Backlash Compensation. Rising frequency of this alarm is an early indicator of ball screw wear.

title: Y-Axis Positioning Deviation
description: Measured axis position deviates from commanded position beyond tolerance.
recommended_action: Check backlash compensation value under Axis > Backlash Compensation. Rising frequency of this alarm is an early indicator of ball screw wear.
